transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. It's nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because... for nearly two years now, I’ve been sure that our contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They're just keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts, and they always have all these excuses, but... I know what they're doing.
Do you think these people are using any special technology or supernatural means to interfere with you?

No, no... nothing like that. I don't think they're using anything supernatural, or any kind of special gadgets. It's just... well, it's just regular people being dishonest. They talk to each other, they make little agreements behind my back... just normal, everyday scheming to drag the work out and get more money out of us. There's no magic or anything involved, just plain greed.
Even when your husband shows you receipts and explanations, are you still completely certain the contractor and neighbors are cheating you?

Yes, I am. I know my husband means well, but... yes. Like I was saying, it's been nearly two years of this, and I am absolutely sure the contractor and those people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us. It really doesn't matter how many receipts my husband shows me, or how many excuses they all come up with. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose, and I just know it.
Have you heard voices when no one was there?
No, I haven't. I don't hear any voices or anything like that. It's just the things I see happening right in front of me with the house.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually high, energetic, or full of ideas?

No, I haven't. I've never had anything like that happen. I'm just a regular person, you know? I don't get all wound up or have a bunch of wild ideas. I just want my kitchen finished so I can have my home back to normal.
Apart from the contractor and your neighbors, do you believe anyone else is trying to harm, cheat, or plot against you?

No, it's just them. I don't think anyone else is involved. It's strictly about the house and the people who have been around it... the contractor and those neighbors. I don't have any reason to think anyone else is trying to do anything to me.
Have you been feeling depressed معظم اليوم nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say I've been depressed. I mean, I get frustrated, obviously, with everything going on with the house and the contractor. It's stressful. But I don't feel down or sad all day, every day. Just... tired of dealing with this whole situation.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or nervous system illness?
No, nothing like that. I haven't had any... brain illnesses or nerve problems. My mind is perfectly fine. I just go in for my regular checkups, but no, there's nothing wrong with my brain.
